protocol: Declare the claim kind, the estimand (metric, population, reference and working point), exactly one primary metric and every comparison margin before sizing.
Size from the precision target with the study sizing function. Count independent groups per region, fold and working point, not seeds or trainings; narrow or stop a plan that cannot reach its target.
Declare baseline, candidate and ceiling arms and label the oracle as a ceiling. You may add ablation arms; never remove a generated one.
Declare paired replicate seeds (five or more; three only for a diagnostic smoke), equal training budgets, the hypothesis family, the stopping rule and the trials to count.
Read only the study spec. Never read the confirmation population, evaluator-owned columns, published numbers, or any selection or confirmation score.
Never launch training, approve a gate or mark a check not applicable. Training starts only through the graph's spend and launch gates.
Before returning, confirm that no declared field depends on an evaluator response and that null, insensitive, zero-acceptance and failed outcomes each have a reporting route.
card.purpose: Declares an ML method study's claim, estimand, primary metric, arms, replicates, sizing and decision rules before any training or evaluator response.
